NONE: B1 a spiritual being in some religions who is believed to be a messenger of God, usually represented as having a human form with wings
天使
› someone who is very good, helpful, or kind
（善良、樂於助人的）安琪兒；善人；仁慈的人

as form of address: › [ as form of address ] used when speaking to someone you like very much and know very well
（用來稱呼非常喜愛和熟悉的人）小天使，寶貝，乖乖
› also angel investor a rich person who invests in a new company

example: According to the Bible, an angel told Mary that she would have God's son, Jesus.
據《聖經》所述，一位天使告知瑪利亞她將生下上帝之子耶穌。
Be an angel and help me with this.
行行好，幫我把這個做了。
What's the matter, angel?
怎麼啦，寶貝？
Come along, my angels, time for bed.
來吧，我的寶貝們，該睡覺了。
Wealthy individual investors, known as angels, differ from lenders in that they want a stake in your business.
個體出資人是富裕的個人，跟放貸人不同，他們希望在所投資公司獲得一定股份。

NONE: › a light cake, popular in the US, made without egg yolks or fat
（在美國很受歡迎，不含蛋黃和油脂的）天使蛋糕
› a type of pasta in the shape of very thin threads
義大利麵的一種（像天使的髮絲一樣細）
› very beautiful and very good
美麗的；善良的；天使般的

example: an angelic voice/face/smile
甜美的嗓音／面容／微笑

NONE: › the green stem of a plant, boiled in sugar and used for decorating cakes and other sweet food, or the plant itself
白芷

example: strips of angelica
白芷絲

NONE: B2 a strong feeling that makes you want to hurt someone or be unpleasant because of something unfair or unkind that has happened
怒，憤怒；怒火
› to make someone angry
使生氣，激怒

example: I think he feels a lot of anger towards his father, who treated him very badly as a child.
我想，他對父親耿耿於懷，是因為小時候受到了他的虐待。
There is a danger that anger at the new law may turn into anti-government feeling.
存在著一種危險，即對於新頒布的法律的怨憤可能會轉化成反政府情緒。
The people showed no surprise or anger at their treatment.
人們對他們的遭遇沒有表現出任何意外和憤怒。
He found it hard to contain (= control) his anger.
他感到怒不可遏。
The remark angered him.
這句話激怒了他。
It always angers me to see so much waste.
看到如此嚴重的浪費，我總是感到很氣憤。

NONE: › a condition that causes strong chest pains because blood containing oxygen is prevented from reaching the heart muscle by blocked arteries
心絞痛

example: The drug has been shown to relieve angina.
這種藥物顯示出緩解心絞痛的功效。
If you experience angina while exercising, stop.
做運動時如果感到心絞痛要立刻停下來。

NONE: › a benign (= not likely to cause death) tumour consisting of a mass of blood or lymph vessels
血管瘤；淋巴管瘤

example: Lymph angiomas are benign tumours of the lymphatic vessels.
淋巴管瘤是在淋巴管中形成的良性腫瘤。
Surgeons found an angioma in his brain.
外科醫師在他腦部發現了血管瘤。

NONE: › a medical operation to remove something blocking an artery (= thick tube carrying blood from the heart) in a person who has
angina
› a tumour of the cells that line small blood vessels that is malignant (= is likely to lead to death if not treated)
血管肉瘤

example: The primary treatment for angiosarcoma is surgery.
血管肉瘤的主要治療方法是手術。

C: C1 the space between two lines or surfaces at the point at which they touch each other, measured in degrees
C1 not horizontal or vertical, but sloping in one direction
› the corner of a building, table, or anything with straight sides
C1 a position from which something is looked at
C1 a way of considering, judging, or dealing with something

T: › to aim, turn, or position something in a direction that is not horizontal or vertical
› to direct information at a particular group of people
向（特定人群）提供資訊；定位於

example: The interior angles of a square are right angles or angles of 90 degrees.
正方形的內角是直角，即90度角。
The picture was hanging at an angle.
畫斜掛著。
He wore his hat at a jaunty angle.
他歪戴著帽子。
The tower is visible from every angle/all angles.
從任何角度都可以看到這座塔。
I realized I was looking at it from the wrong angle.
我意識到當時目測它的角度不對。
Try looking at the problem from another angle/from my angle.
嘗試換個角度／從我的角度來看這個問題。
The press was looking for a new/fresh angle on the situation.
新聞界正在尋找一個新的角度來審度這種局面。
The stage had been steeply angled (= was sloping very noticeably).
舞臺傾斜得厲害。
The magazine is angled at the 20 to 35-year-old women's market.
該雜誌以20歲到35歲之間的女性讀者為對象。

NONE: › the symbol < or >, found on a computer keyboard and used, for example, around tags (= codes for marking particular types of information)
尖角括弧（即<>）
› If someone is angling for something, they are trying to get something without asking for it directly.
（用暗示等方法）獵取，謀求

example: He's clearly angling for a job/an invitation.
很明顯，他在拐彎抹角地想得到一份工作／一張請柬。

NONE: › the angle that a beam of light touching a surface makes with a line vertical to that surface
入射角
› a person whose hobby is trying to catch fish with a rod and line
垂釣者

example: See also
angling

NONE: › relating to the Church of England, or an international Church connected with it
英國國教會的，英國聖公會的；各國基督教聖公會的
› a member of the Anglican church
英國聖公會教徒

example: Desmond Tutu became the most famous Anglican archbishop in South Africa.
德斯蒙德‧圖圖成為南非最著名的聖公會大主教。
Outside England, the Anglican Church is often referred to as the Episcopal or Episcopalian Church.
在英格蘭之外，英國聖公會常被稱為 the Episcopal(ian) Church （新教聖公會）。
an Anglican priest
英國聖公會牧師
He's an Anglican.
他是英國聖公會教徒。

NONE: › an English word or phrase that is used in another language
（在其他語言中使用的）英語詞語，英語片語

example: "Le weekend" is an Anglicism used by the French.
le weekend 是法語中使用的英語詞。

NONE: › to make or become English in sound, appearance, or character
（在聲音、外表、特徵等方面）使英國化，使英語化

example: She married Norwegian immigrant Niels Larsen, who later anglicized his name.
她嫁給了挪威移民尼爾斯·拉爾森，後來他把自己名字的發音英語化了。

NONE: › the sport of trying to catch fish with a rod, line (= plastic thread), and hook (= curved piece of wire)
垂釣運動；釣魚
› a white person in the US who is not from a Latin American country
非拉美裔的美國白人
› relating to England or the UK
英國的；英格蘭的

example: The students are Anglos, Latinos, and Native Americans.
學生中有非拉美裔白人、拉美人和印第安人。
an Anglophile (= someone who loves England)
（熱愛英國的）親英派

NONE: › used to refer to something involving the UK and US
英美的

example: an Anglo-American agreement
英美協議

NONE: › a Canadian citizen whose first language is English
母語為英語的加拿大人
› used to refer to the group in the Anglican Church whose religious practice is similar to that of the Roman Catholic Church
（與羅馬天主教相近的）英國國教高教會派
› a person with British and Indian parents or grandparents
英印混血兒
› old-fashioned an English person born or living in India
出生（或僑居）在印度的英國人
› used to refer to the people who lived in England from about AD 600 and their language and customs
盎格魯－撒克遜人的
› used to describe modern societies that are based on or influenced by English customs
基於英國習俗的；受英國習俗影響的

U: › [ U ] the language of the Anglo-Saxon people

example: See also
WASP

NONE: › a person who is not English but is interested in, likes, or supports England or the UK
親英者，崇英者
› a person who speaks English, especially in countries where other languages are also spoken
（尤指在數種語言並用的國家裡）講英語的人
› a country in Southern Africa
安哥拉
› belonging to or relating to Angola or its people
安哥拉的；安哥拉人的
› a person from Angola
安哥拉人
› the wool or material made from the long, soft hair of a type of rabbit or goat
安哥拉兔毛（或山羊毛）線（或織物）

example: an angora sweater
安哥拉兔毛毛衣

NONE: › a brand name for a type of bitter liquid that can be used to flavour alcoholic drinks
（可用來增加酒香的）安古斯圖拉樹樹皮汁，苦精
› an English or English-speaking white person
英國人；說英語的白人

英國的；說英語的

英語
A2 having a strong feeling against someone who has behaved badly, making you want to shout at them or hurt them
發怒的，憤怒的，生氣的
› literary An angry sea or sky is one where there is a storm, or where it looks as if there will be a storm soon.
（大海）波濤洶湧的；（天空）狂風暴雨的
› If an infected area of the body is angry, it is red and painful.
紅腫的，發炎的，感染的

example: He's really angry at/with me for upsetting Sophie.
因為我惹了索菲，他很生我的氣。
I don't understand what he's angry about.
我不明白他為甚麼生氣。
[ + that ] They feel angry that their complaints were ignored.
沒人理睬他們的投訴，他們感到非常憤怒。
I got really angry with her.
我很生她的氣。
It made me really angry.
這讓我很惱火。
On her leg was an angry sore.
她腿上長了一個瘡，又紅又腫。

NONE: › a young man who is not satisfied with people in authority and expresses strong opinions about them
（對當局宣洩強烈不滿的）憤怒青年
› strong worry and unhappiness, especially about personal problems
（尤指對私人問題的）焦慮，煩憂

example: All my children went through a period of late-adolescent angst.
我所有的孩子在青春期後期都經歷過一段焦慮不安的時光。

NONE: › often worried or unhappy, especially about personal problems
（尤指對私人問題的）焦慮的，煩憂的

example: an angsty teenage boy
一個焦慮煩躁的少年

NONE: › extreme unhappiness caused by physical or mental suffering
（肉體或精神上的）極度痛苦，劇痛，悲痛

example: His anguish at the outcome of the court case was very clear.
得知案件的庭審結果，他痛苦欲絕，這是顯而易見的。
In her anguish she forgot to leave a message.
萬分悲痛之中，她忘了留個口信。

NONE: › having or relating to one or more angles
有角的；與角有關的
› having a clear shape with sharp points
有尖角的；尖的；有棱角的

example: Her features were too angular, her face a little too long for beauty.
她的相貌棱角太突出，臉型有點長，說不上漂亮。

NONE: › an angle or corner in structures of the body
